s1.name: The Lighthouse
s1.brief: Deliver the first order of the day. Cruise ships are in — the gringos want to try the famous Churchill.

s2.name: Paseo de los Turistas
s2.brief: The boardwalk is packed. Cross the promenade dodging tourists and carnival troupes.

s3.name: Market & Cathedral
s3.brief: Downtown streets are narrow and traffic is unforgiving. Watch the cats — and Father Ramírez doesn't like waiting.

s4.name: Sunset at Las Playitas
s4.brief: The sun sets over the Yacht Club. Open the throttle on Route 17 — but careful, the football team is out training.

s5.name: Storm at El Cocal
s5.brief: The downpour hit and the asphalt is slick. Reach Route 17 before the storm gets worse.

s6.name: Bridge · Mata de Limón
s6.brief: Cross the suspension bridge over the estuary. Reach the Mata de Limón kiosk and the Leda seafood house.

s7.name: Caldera · Finale
s7.brief: Down Route 27 to the Port of Caldera. The sun is coming up — one last delivery and the shift is done.

s8.name: Estuary Crossing
s8.brief: Run the lancha down the channel to Pitahaya. Dodge the fishermen's pangas and the mangrove roots — three hits and she goes down. Cut through the shoals: land with fish and you land better.
